title: Benefit Street Partners 使用 Codex 支持代码审查与快速跟进
english: OpenAI News describes how Anant Kumar at Benefit Street Partners builds tools for comparing loan valuations and analyzing credit agreements. Kumar uses Codex for code review and to help respond to follow-up questions faster. The example places an AI coding tool within a financial analysis workflow, where the underlying software supports comparisons and document analysis. The source identifies code review and faster follow-ups as uses of Codex, but it does not provide implementation details, performance metrics, or a breakdown of how the review process works.
